locator: A5P1, complete necessary-conditional question, contingent-situation/obtain titles and negative-answer continuation
interpretation: The question is not actual respondent assent. A5C2–3 names the whole conditional Something Uncausable and attributes its nonnecessity. Retain obtaining-situation membership inside the conditional and the scope of the outer necessity; do not replace this by the shorter alternate question or by a claim that every actual situation actually has a cause.
